# Altora Indonesia

> Altora Indonesia (brand: Altora) is an Indonesian company headquartered in Samarinda, East Kalimantan, with branch offices in Balikpapan (Balikpapan Utara and Pasar Baru). It builds custom software and websites, and procures, installs, and maintains hardware from official principals for businesses, institutions, campuses, and government agencies.

## Identity
- Legal/brand name: Altora Indonesia
- Short name: Altora
- Former identity: Algora Teknologi Indonesia (Algora)
- Official website: https://altora.id/
- Rebrand information: https://altora.id/algora
- Head office: Perum Graha Indah Blok A13, Air Putih, Samarinda Ulu, Samarinda
- Branches: Jl. Soekarno Hatta, Muara Rapak, Balikpapan Utara; Pasar Baru, Balikpapan
- Official partners (principals): TP-Link | VIGI, Teltonika, Lenovo, HDe, HaganeRack, Fasser (Starlink kits procured and installed by Altora, not a partnership)
- Registered supplier on Inaproc/LKPP (Indonesian government procurement)
- Contact: hello@altora.id, WhatsApp +62 851-9091-1170 (https://wa.me/6285190911170)

## What Altora does
- Custom software: web apps, mobile apps, and internal systems built around the client's own workflow
- Websites and SEO for companies, campuses, and government institutions
- Hardware procurement from official principals, with installation and maintenance: CCTV (VIGI), networking (TP-Link), GPS trackers (Teltonika), laptops/PCs/servers (Lenovo), displays and kiosks (HDe), server racks (HaganeRack), fiber tools (Fasser)
- Starlink satellite internet kits, procured and installed
- Electrical and network installation, IT support, signage and kiosks
